provenance.temporal_resolution: daily (accumulated from half-hourly IMERG Early; UTC day)
processing: OPeNDAP subsets of `precipitation` (mm/day, UTC days) from GPM_3IMERGDE V07 only, IMERG grid indices lon 1000-1004, lat 863-867
catchment mean = area-weighted mean of 0.1 degree cells (weights = fraction inside processed/aoi/catchment.geojson, rasterised at 0.001 degree; 7 cells, total weight 2.066 cell-equivalents)
a day with any missing weighted cell or no granule stays missing (empty cell)
72 h total = sum of 3 consecutive UTC-day catchment means (unrounded); windows with a missing day are not ranked
declustered: windows sorted by total, a window is kept only if it shares no day with a kept window; 1233 events; top 15
provenance.notes: Top-15 heaviest 72 h upstream rain events, single product.
